content: Depit Wiahla Nanmwarkien Suda

Mwurin mepwukat Depit ahpw kalelapak rehn KAUN-O, patohwan, “Maing, ia duwe, I en patolahng ale ehu kahnimw kan en Suda?” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ei, kohwei.” A Depit pil patohwan, “Mehnia, maing?” KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Epron.”
Depit eri patohla Epron, iangahki eh pwoud riemeno, Ahinoam mehn Sesreel, oh Apikail, liohdio, en Napal me melahro eh pwoud, mehn Karmel.
Depit pil kahrehda nah sounpei ko oh ar peneinei kan. Irail eri kohla oh kousoanla nan kahnimw kan me kapilpene Epron.
Mehn Suda kan eri kohdo Epron oh keiehdi Depit en wiahla nanmwarkien Suda. Eri, ni Depit eh karongehda me mehn Sapes kan, nan Kilead, sarepedier Sohl,
e ahpw poaronehla sapwellime aramas ekei pwe re en kairehki mehn Kilead, “KAUN-O en ketin kupwuramwahwih kumwail pwehki amwail loalopwoatohng amwail nanmwarki ni amwail sarepedi.
Eri, KAUN-O en pil ketin kupwurkalahngan oh loalopwoatohng kumwail. I pahn pil apwalih kumwail mwahu pwehki me kumwail wiadahro.
Kumwail kehlail oh kommwad! Amwail nanmwarki Sohl sipallahr, oh mehn Suda kan keieiedier pwe I en wiahla arail nanmwarki.”
Isposed Wiahla Nanmwarkien Israel
Apner nein Ner, kaunen sapwellimen Sohl karis, ahpw iang sapwellimen Sohl pwutak, Isposed sopohla oh kotehla Sordan kolahng Mahanaim.
Apner ahpw wiahkihla Isposed nanmwarkien nan sapwen Kilead, Aser, Sesreel, Epraim, oh Pensamin, oh nan Israel pwon.
E sounpar pahisek ni ahnsou me e wiahla nanmwarkien Israel, oh e kakaunki erein sounpar riau. Ahpw kadaudok en Suda kin loalopwoatohng Depit,
oh e kakaunki Suda nan Epron erein sounpar isuh elep.
Mahwen Nanpwungen Israel oh Suda
Apner oh sapwellimen Isposed lapalap akan ahpw mweselsang Mahanaim ketilahng kahnimw Kipeon.
Sohap, me eh nohno Seruaia, oh ekei nein Depit lapalap teiko ahpw tuhwong irail pohn leho, wasa irail koaros mwohndi ie, ehu pwihn apali, a ehu pwihn apali.
Apner ahpw ndahng Sohap, “Kitail kihpene ekei mwahnakapw sang pali riau pwukat pwe re en siai en pei. Sohap eri sapeng, “Me mwahu.”
Eri, ohl ehk riemen me wia wiliepen Isposed oh kadaudok en Pensamin, irail eri peiong nein Depit pil ohl ehk riemen.
Emenemen ohl alehte moangen me e uhwong oh doakoahki nah kedlahs ni pengepenge, eri irail koaros me riehk pahmeno mehla. Ihme kahrehda wasao nan Kipeon adanekihki “Mohs en Kedlahs.”
Lapalahn pei ehu ahpw wiawi, Apner oh mehn Israel ko eri lohdi pahn nein Depit sounpei ko.
Nein Seruaia pwutak silimen ko iang mihmi wasao: Sohap, Apisai, oh Asahel. Asahel, iei ih me kin tang marahra duwehte tie,
ahpw pwakih Apner, e tangete inenlahng.
Apner ahpw kilengla mwuri oh nda, “Asahel, kowe men?” E ahpw sapeng nda, “Ei.”
Apner ahpw nda, “Ke dehr pwakih ie, pwakihala emen sounpei ko oh kihsang eh dipwisou.” Ahpw Asahel pwakipwakihete.
Apner pil pwurehng ndalahng, “Ke dehr pwakih ie! Ke nannantihong I en kemeiukala? Ia pahn mwomwei ong riomw pwutak Sohap?”

Ahpw Asahel sohte men uhdihsang; Apner sohte pirekeklahng ahpw doangkilahng nah ketieuwo lel kapehde oh pwerla nan tihnsewe. Asahel eri pwupwudi mehla, oh koaros me iang kohdo wasa me e pwupwudieo ahpw uhdi oh nennenla wasao.
Apisai oh Sohap ahpw pwakihala Apner, ira ahpw lellahng pohn dohl en Amma ni ketipin eh kihrlahr, wasao mi palimesehn Kia ni ahl me kohlahng sapwtehn en Kipeon.
Ohl ako me sang kadaudok en Pensamin ahpw kapilpene Apner oh sinsile pohn dohlo.

Apner ahpw likwerlahng Sohap, ketihtihki, “Dah, kitail pahn pepei sohte tokedi? Ke sohte ese me nsensuwedte me pahn wiawi ni imwilahn mepwukat? Kitail tohn wehiteieu. Iahd me ke pahn ndahng noumw ohl akan re en tokedihsang ar pwakipwakih kiht?”
Sohap ahpw sapeng, nda, “I kahukihla ni mwaren Koht ieias, ma ke sohte lokaia, nei ohl akan pahn pwakipwakihiuk lao lel nimenseng en lakapw.”
Sohap eri peuk sowi pwehn wia kilel ehu ong nah ohl ako me re en tokedihsang ar pwakipwakih mehn Israel ko; peio ahpw tokedi.
Apner oh nah sounpei ko ahpw karis kolahng Wahun Sordan erein pwohngo pwon; re kotehla Pillap Sordan, oh mwurin ar karikaris kohla nimensengo, re ahpw lellahng Mahanaim.
Ni Sohap eh tokedihsang eh pwepwekio, e ahpw kihpene nah ohl koaros oh diarada me irail me ehk duwemen me sohte mie, likin Asahel.
Nein Depit ohl ako kemehla nein Apner ohl 360 sang kadaudok en Pensamin.
Sohap oh nah ohl ako ahpw ale paliweren Asahel oh wahla sarepedi nan sousoun peneinei nan Pedleem. Re ahpw karikaris nipwongo pwon pwurupwuralahng Epron, re lel mwo nin sohrahn.
